KEEP all TWENTY-FOUR original body/arm/hand/leg poses, facial features, proportions, tactile textures, colors, the small stone mask and wiry hair, body scale, camera angle, foot baseline and exact tile placements UNCHANGED. No backdrop, floor, ground, shadow, checkerboard, grid lines, labels, numbers or text. The ONLY intended visual change is removing the bricks while keeping the original articulated character action.
build.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 2D SPRITE SHEET for a small website character building a little brick wall.
Input image 1 is the sole CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, not a sheet to copy. Draw new articulated poses of this EXACT observer: huge textured red sculptural face, vivid BLUE upper eyelids with dark green lower eyelids, white dotted cheeks, yellow beads on pink facial piping, small grey stone mask with wiry white hair on the head, orange-brown HUMAN arms and feet, black/white/green zebra hip form, blue gingham rounded thigh and yellow mesh-patterned other thigh. Preserve these tactile sculpture/collage materials, face proportions and details in EVERY frame. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. Full body and props visible, clean cutout edges. Eyes open, fixed near-frontal three-quarter camera. This is an actual production animation sprite sheet; use genuinely different limb, knee, hand and body poses rather than duplicating or translating one still.
MANDATORY LAYOUT: EXACTLY TWENTY-FOUR frames in a precise SIX equal columns by FOUR equal rows grid, ordered left to right, then next row. Overall canvas landscape 3:2 (1536x1024 or larger equivalent). All 24 cells square and identical framing. Each cell contains ONE version of the same character, kept on the LEFT half of that cell, and its brick-building action on the RIGHT half. Same character scale, same camera, same foot baseline at 94% cell height. No body parts cross cells; generous transparent gutters. The character's feet stay grounded, only natural knee bends and bobbing. Three simple tactile terracotta clay bricks are the ONLY props. Brick structure remains anchored in the same spot at the right of each cell.
STORY: a coherent longer build action, ONE new sequential pose per cell:
1 stands beside three loose bricks; 2 looks down and bends knees; 3 squats reaching for first brick; 4 grips first brick with both hands; 5 rises with brick at waist; 6 pivots body a little toward the right-hand building spot; 7 lowers the brick carefully with both hands; 8 places first brick on ground at right; 9 releases it and straightens.
10 turns back and bends for second brick; 11 grips second brick; 12 lifts it to waist; 13 leans toward the structure; 14 places second brick NEXT TO the first as a two-brick base row; 15 presses and aligns that base row with hands; 16 straightens and looks at the base.
17 squats for the final third brick; 18 lifts it to waist with both hands; 19 raises it to chest; 20 extends it over the two-brick base; 21 lowers and places the third brick across the join of the base, creating a small two-level three-brick wall; 22 gently pats its top; 23 steps a little back admiring the tiny wall, hands on hips; 24 relaxed proud standing pose beside the complete wall. Bricks must visibly progress from loose to stacked and remain physically consistent between frames. No hammer, trowel, tools, hats or extra objects.
BACKGROUND: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside character and bricks, including gaps between limbs. NO floor, ground plane, shadows, backdrop, grid lines, tile borders, labels, numbers, words or watermark. No random colored speckles or ghost silhouettes outside the bodies. Preserve identity, scale, cell placement and transparency across the sheet.

Draw new articulated poses of this EXACT observer: huge textured red sculptural face, vivid BLUE upper eyelids with dark green lower eyelids, white dotted cheeks, yellow beads on pink facial piping, small grey stone mask with wiry white hair on the head, orange-brown HUMAN arms and feet, black/white/green zebra hip form, blue gingham rounded thigh and yellow mesh-patterned other thigh. Maintain the character's tactile facial/body identity and natural two-arm/two-leg anatomy. The motion should feel playful, slightly deliberate and charming, with visibly articulated knees, ankles, shoulders and hands.
BACKGROUND: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside character including between limbs. NO floor, ground plane, drop shadows, backdrop, grid lines, tile borders, frame labels, numbers, words or watermark. No random colored speckles, haze or ghost silhouettes. No new clothes, hats, accessories, props or other characters.
